description: This file contains implementation of control functions for a concert sound processing module, including parameter retrieval, control, and timer callback handling, with references to external sound processing components and tables.

methods.name: LVCS_GetParameters
methods.description: Retrieves current sound parameters from an instance.

methods.name: LVCS_Control
methods.description: Sets or updates sound processing parameters, handling reinitialization and mode transitions.

methods.name: LVCS_TimerCallBack
methods.description: Handles timer expiration events to update instance state.
